qa_pairs.instruction: What is the purpose of auditing in the Bi Impl Nx driver?
qa_pairs.output: Auditing in the Bi Impl Nx driver is used to track changes to sensitive information and allows administrators to examine audit logs periodically.

qa_pairs.instruction: How can you monitor the operation of the Bi Impl Nx driver using NetIQ Audit?
qa_pairs.output: To monitor the operation of the Bi Impl Nx driver with NetIQ Audit, enable auditing for the driver and then review the generated audit logs. For detailed steps and configuration, refer to the NetIQ Audit Documentation website at http://www.novell.com/documentation/novellaudit20/index.html.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the auditing guidance for the Bi Impl Nx driver.
qa_pairs.output: The Bi Impl Nx driver recommends enabling auditing to track changes to sensitive data, reviewing the audit logs on a regular basis, and consulting the NetIQ Audit Documentation site for detailed instructions on using NetIQ Audit to monitor driver activity.
